newsitem.title: USA: Cintas names Farmer president, COO. [CORRECTED 15:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Cintas names Farmer president, COO. [CORRECTED 15:00 GMT]

text.p: Cintas Corp said Tuesday it named Scott Farmer president and chief operating officer.
In a statement, the company said Farmer is a 15-year company veteran who has served in a variety of roles, including president of Cintas Sales Corp.

In the same statement, Cintas said it "is poised to break the $1 billion barrier" next fiscal year (corrects year). The company did not elaborate on the forecast and a company spokeswoman was not immediately available to comment.
Through three quarters of the current fiscal year, Cintas earned $64.8 million on $611.3 million in revenues.

Cintas also said it named Robert Buck president of its uniform rental division, the company's largest unit. Buck previously served as chief financial officer and vice president of uniform service locations in the Midwest, it said.
